canonical_questions: Can I change my shipping address?
I entered the wrong address for my order
How do I update the delivery address?
knowledge_snippet: You can update the shipping address for an order within 1 hour of placing it by contacting support with the order number; after that the order may already be in fulfillment.
system_instruction: Answer only about changing a shipping address, use order_id for personalization.
answer_template: For order {order_id}: address changes are only possible within 1 hour of placing the order.
escalation_fallback: If the order may already be in fulfillment, please contact a human agent.
